paths.description: Primary race-information landing page and global navigation; tested desktop, fixed-width mobile rendering, dark/reduced-motion preferences, search overlay, performance, privacy, accessibility and memory.
News listing template and news search entry point; represents content listings and category tabs.
Race-calendar/data table template, selected because dense schedules are a high-risk responsive and metadata surface.
Beginner guide/content landing page, representing educational content and a key path for new users.
News search results journey reached by the search form action with a representative Japanese query.
Unknown-route recovery state; server returned a branded Forbidden page with explanation, contact and home links.

findings.summary: No dark color-scheme adaptation
findings.evidence: The preference probe matched dark mode but reported color-scheme: normal and body text rgb(51,51,51); the emulated-dark screenshot retains white surfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and derive surfaces/text from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Primary carousel does not fully respect reduced motion
findings.evidence: The CSS context shows the only reduced-motion rule comes from Font Awesome. The main carousel has no reduction rule, and the reduced-motion screenshot caught an in-progress dark cross-fade.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable autoplay and collapse nonessential carousel transitions under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Page and state changes do not use transition continuity
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS probes found no authored view-transition-name or transition API usage across the representative templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route/state continuity, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Carousel and scroll effects rely on legacy libraries rather than scroll timelines
findings.evidence: The resource probe found jQuery, Slick and Swiper, while the authored CSS probe found no animation-timeline usage.
findings.suggestedFix: For scroll-linked effects, replace main-thread/library coupling with CSS scroll-driven animation where it improves feedback.

findings.summary: Search modal is a non-semantic fixed div and loses focus
findings.evidence: After opening search, the visible #modal is a DIV without role=dialog or aria-modal, and document.activeElement is BODY. No dialog or popover exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> with showModal(), a labelled heading, focus placement/restoration and platform Escape dismissal.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome overwhelms the first viewport
findings.evidence: The desktop screenshot shows four dense navigation/header rows before content; the 360px capture scales that entire desktop chrome and its small labels into the viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the race tasks and move secondary destinations into a compact, progressively disclosed menu.

findings.summary: Homepage uses a fixed 1200px viewport on phones
findings.evidence: The homepage declares meta viewport width=1200. At a 360x800 device viewport, layout reports a 1200 CSS-pixel viewport at scale 0.3, making the whole desktop page tiny rather than reflowing.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and responsive layout rules instead of shrinking a fixed desktop canvas.

findings.summary: Components do not adapt to their available container
findings.evidence: Across four templates the CSS probes found zero container rules; the homepage instead forces width=1200 and links to a separate smartphone site.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type on reusable modules and @container rules for cards, nav and schedule content.

findings.summary: Some mobile targets are too small or tightly spaced
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 15px-high news links with less than the required safe spacing; dense scaled homepage controls are also visibly small at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Give interactive controls at least 24x24 CSS pixels of target area, preferably 44x44 for primary touch actions, while retaining :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is far outside the good threshold
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured homepage LCP 23.3s and news LCP 6.9s; the raw trace corroborated homepage LCP 6.80s, FCP 3.87s and 84.5ms TBT under a separate run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP resource, reduce server/document latency and remove blocking dependencies before the hero/content.

findings.summary: The homepage ships a large, blocking resource graph
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 159 requests and 4.84MB transferred, including 3.71MB images. DOM confirmation shows multiple synchronous head scripts; Lighthouse estimates 2.15s render-blocking savings and 3.8MB cache savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer noncritical scripts, consolidate critical CSS, set durable cache headers and prioritise only the LCP asset.

findings.summary: Large amounts of CSS and JavaScript are unused on initial load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 301KiB unused JavaScript and 40KiB unused CSS on home, plus legacy JavaScript and unminified CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by template, remove legacy shims/plugins where native platform features suffice, and load analytics after consent/need.

findings.summary: Interactive and image semantics are invalid or missing
findings.evidence: axe found critical missing alt text on two meaningful images and a focusable element inside aria-hidden. Lighthouse on news found prohibited ARIA and broken tab role parent/child relationships.
findings.suggestedFix: Repair the tab pattern, remove focusability from hidden slides and add meaningful alt or explicit decorative treatment.

findings.summary: Pages lack main landmarks and contain broken focus structure
findings.evidence: axe/Lighthouse report no main landmark; news uses tabindex=1 and malformed tab/list roles. The search modal opens with focus left on BODY.
findings.suggestedFix: Add <main>, keep natural tabindex order, implement the ARIA tabs pattern correctly and manage dialog focus.

findings.summary: The homepage does not reflow at a phone-sized viewport
findings.evidence: meta viewport width=1200 shrinks content to 30% scale at 360px, and Lighthouse flags undersized news touch targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt device-width responsive reflow and enlarge/space touch targets without disabling zoom.

findings.summary: Homepage logs a browser console error
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed errors-in-console with one recorded browser error.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix the originating request/script error and keep production console error-free.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic dimensions at scale
findings.evidence: The image primitive found all 100 homepage images lacked width/height attributes; 45 were oversized and 69 had empty/missing alt (many decorative, but two were independently confirmed meaningful).
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio and correctly classify decorative versus informative images.

findings.summary: Legacy and cookie issues surface in DevTools
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports Inspector cookie issues, 33KiB legacy-JavaScript savings and third-party-cookie usage; the page loads jQuery 3.5.1 and compatibility shims synchronously.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove obsolete compatibility code, update dependencies and resolve browser Issues-panel warnings.

findings.summary: Important content templates omit meta descriptions
findings.evidence: The metadata probes found no description on the race calendar or beginner guide, although titles were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add concise unique descriptions matching each page purpose.

findings.summary: The canonical homepage is not mobile-friendly
findings.evidence: The homepage viewport is width=1200 and is rendered at scale 0.3 on a 360px device; Lighthouse SEO is 0.85 despite crawlable raw HTML.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a responsive canonical page with device-width viewport rather than relying on a separate smartphone URL.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete across templates
findings.evidence: The calendar has no canonical link, and a direct /sitemap.xml request returned HTTP 403 while robots.txt allows crawling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-referential canonicals to indexable templates and publish an accessible sitemap index referenced from robots.txt.

findings.summary: Structured and social metadata coverage is inconsistent
findings.evidence: All four page probes found zero JSON-LD; the calendar has no Open Graph metadata and the beginner OG description is empty.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD and complete Open Graph metadata for major templates.

findings.summary: Sensitive browser policy headers are missing
findings.evidence: HTTPS, HSTS, nosniff and SAMEORIGIN are present, but the header audit found no Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, strict referrer policy and least-privilege permissions policy; test in report-only first.

findings.summary: Tracking starts with a broad third-party footprint
findings.evidence: The page contacted 13 third-party origins and five known tracker domains. HAR attributes 26 requests and 776,864 bytes to third parties; no consent control was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors/events, delay optional tracking until a valid user choice, and document data purposes and retention.

findings.summary: Cookie and policy defenses are incomplete
findings.evidence: All five observed first-party analytics cookies lacked Secure; four used SameSite=None and two persisted for 400 days. CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy were absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark HTTPS cookies Secure, avoid SameSite=None unless required, shorten retention and add defensive response policies.

findings.summary: Overlay runtime behavior is not robust for keyboard users
findings.evidence: The custom search overlay opens without a dialog role or aria-modal and focus falls to BODY, so keyboard and assistive-technology state is not preserved.
findings.suggestedFix: Use the native dialog lifecycle and explicitly restore focus to the invoking search control on close.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes substantial bandwidth
findings.evidence: The image audit found 45 oversized images, 38 legacy-format images, 34 without responsive sources and 51 below-fold images without lazy loading. Lighthouse estimates 2.36MB image savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate right-sized AVIF/WebP variants, use srcset/sizes and lazy-load below-fold media while prioritising only the LCP image.

findings.summary: Optional tracking creates wasteful background work
findings.evidence: The homepage initiates 26 third-party requests and loads multiple analytics/advertising stacks, including 776KB third-party transfer, without an observed consent gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate measurement stacks, batch essential analytics and defer background work.

findings.summary: Page and third-party weight exceed a proportionate budget
findings.evidence: HAR measured 4.84MB over 159 requests, with 3.71MB images and 776KB third-party bytes; the largest two hero images alone transfer 613KB and 541KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set template budgets for total, image and third-party bytes and enforce them in CI.
